replies.author: Krrish
replies.body: Was referring to my other comment, not about the lag issues. although i did a bit of research and apparently switching a 1.8 server to a 1.7 fixes the lag. But the lag really depends on the computer it is running on, if it has sufficient RAM, the server LAN connection, and where the LAN is broadcasting. SO if it broadcasting in Europe and people are playing in the US Then there is going to be lag for the us not the eu which solves why some other players don't experience the lag.
